lines.en: I keep low and move fast through the trees.
My sickle claws ride above the grass.

lines.zh: 覆羽的背脊在光里发亮。
lines.en: My feathered back shines in the light.
One stride clears the whole trail.
I run low, tail held straight.
Several of us close in together.
I go around the rock and take the flank.
My claw presses down and the grass bends.
My head stays fixed ahead.
The sickle claw has stepped on you.
I take the shortest route.

lines.zh: 我在两个同伴之间穿过去。
lines.en: I pass between two of my companions.
My breathing is steady.
Every step lands precisely.

lines.zh: 我从灌木的缺口钻过去。
lines.en: I slip through a gap in the brush.
I break into a run and my feathers stream back.

lines.zh: 我站着，一条腿微微抬起。
lines.en: I stand with one leg slightly lifted.
I tilt my head to the sounds of the wood.
My tail sways slowly, adjusting balance.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地面刮了两下。
lines.en: I scrape the ground twice with a claw.
I stare at the open ground beyond.
My companions lie in wait on the other side.
I pant, teeth showing white.
My eyes have not left it.
My feathers ruffle, then lie flat.

lines.zh: 我这只镰刀爪，抬起来了。
lines.en: My sickle claw is lifted.
There is not much prey in this wood.

lines.zh: 我把头放低到草的高度。
lines.en: I lower my head to the height of the grass.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里有低低的响声。
lines.en: A low sound sits in my throat.
I turn, feathers ruffling.
One sickle claw raised — one stroke.
There are two more behind me.
Our claws can open a belly.

lines.zh: 我脚上这把镰刀，抬起来了。
lines.en: The sickle claw on my foot is raised.
I am counting your feet.

lines.zh: 你手里那根木棍不够长。
lines.en: That stick of yours is not long enough.
Your back is very inviting.
Do not think of running. We are faster.
I raise my head only to look at you.
My call is for my companions.
I shriek and fall back.
My feathers are wet with blood.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，羽毛贴着泥。
lines.en: I flatten down, feathers against the mud.

lines.zh: 我的镰爪抬在草上，还没落下。
lines.en: My sickle claw is up over the grass, not yet down.
I twist to bite near the wound.
My leg drags a little.
A companion calls back to me.

lines.zh: 我退到蕨丛后，喘得急促。
lines.en: I fall back behind the ferns, panting hard.
Blood is on the grass blades.
My sickle claws are steady — I can stand.
I smell meat.
Do not move that hand any closer.
My companions will come for it first.
I take it and run.
This is not enough to share.

lines.zh: 我撕着肉，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I tear the meat without looking away from you.
Throw it. Do not hand it over.
Our teeth tear quickly.
It vanished the moment it landed.
This piece of meat is mine.

lines.zh: 我被撞得退了半步，尾巴一甩。
lines.en: Knocked back half a step, my tail whips.
My shoulder is hard; my teeth are harder.
My sickle claw digs in — I hold.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，草碎了一片。
lines.en: We collided and crushed a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 这一下你惹上我们全部。
lines.en: Now you have all of us.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，从你腋下钻过。
lines.en: I turn and slip under your arm.
My claw scrapes your legging.
Back off. Do not stand in the middle.

lines.zh: 镰刀爪一抬，羽毛都竖了。
lines.en: Sickle claw raised, and my feathers stand.
All three of us moved.
We close in from three sides.
Hold that side. Do not let it run.
Leave its legs to me.
I bite first; you finish.
Our footsteps must match.
One call, and we begin.
I keep half a step behind you.
Once the prey is down, do not squabble.
This wood can feed us all.
We rush together. Do not split.
I snatch it up and run off.
One press of my claw pins it still.
This bone goes back to the nest.
I tear it into two.
There is bone in it; hard to chew.
I carry it with my head up.
A little blood is left on the ground.
I spit it out and pick it up again.
Too hard. I give it up.
My companions are watching me.
The fern dips — I see you.

lines.zh: 尾羽一压，我准备窜出去。
lines.en: Tail feathers low, I'm ready to bolt.
You have walked into our circle.
One call from me and my companions move.
Your knees are the target.
We come from three directions.
Back to the tree and it is over.
My claws have left the ground.
The ring is tighter than last time.
Do not bother choosing a direction.
I go in first.
Speed is what we have.
I move in close along the grass.

lines.zh: 两个同伴已经绕到你侧面。
lines.en: Two packmates are already flanking you.

lines.zh: 你每回头一次，我就近一点。
lines.en: Each time you look back, I am nearer.
My sickle claws have lifted.
Your back is exposed.

lines.zh: 风声盖住了我们的脚步。
lines.en: The wind covers our footsteps.
All three sides have tightened.
At three, I spring.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸我听得很清，羽毛贴着风。
lines.en: I hear your breathing clearly; my feathers ride the wind.
My teeth are on your shadow.

lines.zh: 跳起来的那一下最要紧。
lines.en: The leap is the crucial part.
You have backed onto rock.
Now — all together.
I leap, both claws leading.
Sickle claws sink into your thigh.
I clamp my teeth on your calf.
A companion hits you from the side.
You are pinned down in the grass.
That bite tore a piece away.
You kicked my chest.
I roll away and rise again.
Blood splashes on my feathers.
I call, and a companion takes my place.
You have caught my tail.
That strike missed.
I step through ferns, quiet.
I am not alone.
Wet soil still clings to my feathers.
I take my place low to the ground.

lines.zh: 林子里响起短促的叫声。
lines.en: Short calls ring through the wood.
First I sniff this ground.
My claws sink into the loose soil.
I come out through a gap in the brush.
Flattened grass marks my way.
We spread out, each finding an angle.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一摆，同伴就懂。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and my companions understand.

lines.zh: 这片蕨林，我踩过每条兽径。
lines.en: I've walked every game trail in these ferns.

lines.zh: 太阳照在我背上的羽毛。
lines.en: Sunlight falls on my back feathers.
I land almost silently.
My feathers scorch and smell.
My hind leg snapped when I fell.
Water fills my mouth and my claws claw at nothing.
The blast flings me into the brush.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进了我的脖侧。
lines.en: An arrow stands in the side of my neck.

lines.zh: 古怪的冷意让我僵了一下。
lines.en: A strange chill locks me up.
The wood is empty and we are all hungry.
Lightning whitewashes the grass.
My sickle claw grasps nothing — no ground below.
